description: The shape of a number over time: a line with no axes, no grid and no tooltip — the trend part of a KPI card, not a chart. Reach for <Meter> when the value is judged against a target instead of against its own past. Copy: the accessible label says what the trend is OF and over what, because the shape alone is unreadable to anyone who cannot see it.

props.name: values
props.description: The series, oldest first. Two points is the minimum that has a shape.

props.name: area
props.description: Fills the area under the line — for a card that carries only this one series.

props.name: label
props.description: What the series measures. Given, the chart is an image to a screen reader; omitted, it is decoration beside a value that already says it.
